type_en: amber cigarette holder in fitted leather case
visual_en: Straight cigarette/cheroot holder of cloudy cognac-to-butterscotch amber with a rose-gold mouth ring and an applied rococo gold cartouche, in its original maroon leather case lined in cream, the lid lining gilt-stamped 'AMBRE VERITABLE' under a crown. Case leather rubbed and worn.
notes_en: #424 case closed, #425 case open; case and holder kept together as one piece.

type_en: carved amber Gdansk coat-of-arms group with two lion supporters
visual_en: Translucent cognac-orange amber carving of two maned lions flanking an oval cartouche engraved with a crown over two crosses between palm branches (the Gdansk/Danzig arms), on a naturalistic base; the back is left smooth. Good condition.
notes_en: Existing folder checked: its 3 photos (front, 3/4, back) show this one object. Not the same object as the K&A raw nugget with a carved Gdansk-arms relief '997-1997' in S07 (#46-#50).

type_en: carved amber bear with two cubs
visual_en: Opaque egg-yolk/butterscotch amber carving of a mother bear with two cubs on a rocky base, with finely textured fur. The underside is natural amber with a dark crust band, engraved with the carver's signature 'Przemyslaw Kus 2009'.
notes_en: Existing folder checked: its 5 photos show one object (#435-#436 are the signed underside). DUPS #431 and #432 are pixel-identical copies of Amb-dec-030-2 (#430); DUPS #434 is a copy of Amb-dec-030-3 (#433).

type_en: steel guillotine cigar cutter with amber-segment handle
visual_en: Chrome/steel lever-guillotine cigar cutter whose handle is inlaid with five cloudy butterscotch-orange amber segments showing natural inclusions and small chips; light wear on the metal.
notes_en: #438 (DSC_9740 copy (1)) is a pixel-identical copy of #439.

type_en: round amber-mosaic coaster/dish with silver insert
visual_en: Round dish whose rim is built from radial segments alternating cognac, butterscotch and milky-yellow amber around a tarnished silver(-plated) metal tray, with green felt underneath.
notes_en: #440 top, #441 side view, #442 rim close-up, #443 felt underside; all the same dish.

type_en: desk clock and thermometer on amber base
visual_en: Pair of gilt-brass drum instruments, a 'Europa 7 Jewels' alarm clock and a Celsius thermometer, on a brass bracket fixed to a rectangular base veneered with reddish-cognac amber tiles; mid-20th century.
notes_en: #445 is the back view. MATERIAL: the base tiles show swirly flow patterns typical of pressed (reconstructed) amber; verify before describing as natural amber.

type_en: amber mosaic box with carved elephant finial
visual_en: Small rectangular lidded box built of irregular polished panels of butterscotch, egg-yolk and milky-yellow amber, with amber-bead feet and corner knobs; the lift-off lid is topped by a small carved amber elephant.
notes_en: #446 (DSC_9836 copy (1)) is a pixel-identical copy of #447. #448-#449 lid off, #450 underside. The elephant is a lid finial, not one of the DEC figurines.

type_en: set of three pierced raw amber nuggets
visual_en: Three natural amber specimens, each pierced with a hole: a large polished egg-yolk orange nugget with leopard-spot weathering pits, a smaller milky-yellow swirled pebble, and a dark-brown crusted elongated piece whose broken edge shows pale opaque amber inside.
notes_en: Always shown together (#451, #454), plus close-ups of the yellow (#452) and dark (#453) stones; the photos cannot be split, so kept as one lot. Kept in ST per the owner's filing, but the drilled holes suggest old amulet/bead use: owner may prefer category A, or 3 separate pieces if sold singly.

type_en: silver beaker set with amber cabochons (SBM Konigsberg)
visual_en: Stemmed 835 silver beaker set around the bowl with heart-shaped butterscotch amber cabochons in bezels; the foot is engraved 'BILDSUCHFAHRT ... ORTSGR. MARIENBURG 18.6.1939' and the inside is marked 835 and SBM (Staatliche Bernstein-Manufaktur Konigsberg). Tarnished silver.
notes_en: #456-#457 cabochon close-ups, #459 hallmarks; #458 (DSC_9923 copy (1)) is a pixel-identical copy of #459. Inscription likely '...DDAC Ortsgr. Marienburg', i.e. a 1939 motoring-event trophy.

type_en: graduated amber bead necklace in original SBM box
visual_en: Graduated necklace of olive-shaped butterscotch-to-cognac amber beads, folded in its original brown fabric-covered case whose satin lid lining is printed 'Staatliche Bernstein-Manufaktur' with the SBM logo.
notes_en: Single photo. Compared with the loose bead necklaces in S18 (#182), S24 (#221) and S25 (#229-#232): no convincing match, so not merged.

type_en: pair of DAF amber stick pins
visual_en: Two Third Reich-era stick pins, each a rectangular opaque orange amber plaque mounted with linked silvered DAF cogwheel-swastika and craft emblems; one keeps its blue tag 'GARANTIERT ECHT BERNSTEIN NB J'. Pins slightly corroded.
notes_en: #463, #465 and #467 are pixel-identical '(1)' copies. Kept as one pair because both pins appear together in #466/#468. Compared with the S36 DAF pin lots (plaque shapes, backs): different objects, so no re-shoot merge. Nazi-era insignia (swastika): check marketplace/legal rules before listing.

type_en: strand of large old amber beads
visual_en: Strand of 11 large barrel- and disc-shaped beads in polished opaque reddish-orange amber with yellow marbling, strung on a green silk cord.
notes_en: #482 (DSC_6651, EXIF time out of sequence) shows the same strand turned around; the rest are bead close-ups. MATERIAL: this 'African/Moroccan trade' bead style is often copal or phenolic-resin imitation; the natural-looking fissures suggest old amber, but this cannot be confirmed from photos.

type_en: rectangular badge with three aircraft on amber plaque
visual_en: Rectangular white-metal-framed brooch badge set with an opaque orange amber plaque bearing three silvered aircraft in formation, with a rusted pin and catch on the back; 1930s German donation-badge style.
notes_en: All 4 files share one EXIF frame: #483 is a front+back composite, #484 a front crop, #486 a back crop; #485 (DSC_6775 copy (1)) is a pixel-identical copy of #486. MATERIAL: the plaque has flow striations, so it may be pressed amber.

type_en: lot of 5 DAF stick pins on natural amber with NB tags
visual_en: Five stick pins, each an irregular polished piece of transparent cognac-to-honey amber (some crackled, with white inclusions) mounted with the linked DAF cogwheel-swastika and craft emblems, and blue shield tags reading 'NATUR-BERNSTEIN NB J' or 'GARANTIERT ECHT BERNSTEIN NB J'.
notes_en: Always photographed together (#487 fan, #488 row, #491 backs, #490 close-up of 3), so kept as one lot; split only if sold singly. #489 is a pixel-identical copy of #490. Nazi-era insignia (swastika): check marketplace/legal rules before listing.

type_en: lot of 7 'Luftsport hilft Deutschland' amber badges
visual_en: Seven identical round pin badges, each with an aluminium rim lettered 'LUFTSPORT HILFT DEUTSCHLAND' around an opaque orange amber disc bearing a metal glider/bird emblem.
notes_en: Count is 7 in #492, #494 and #496 (backs); #495 is a close-up of one badge. #493 is a pixel-identical copy of #494. MATERIAL: the discs show flow lines typical of pressed amber (Pressbernstein); verify.

type_en: lot of 5 DAF stick pins on opaque amber
visual_en: Five untagged stick pins with the linked DAF cogwheel-swastika and craft emblems, mounted on opaque amber pieces: a rectangular plaque, two round discs, an oval and an irregular egg-yolk yellow piece.
notes_en: Always shown together (#497 fronts, #498 backs, #500 close-up of 3), so kept as one lot. #499 is a pixel-identical copy of #500. A different set from the tagged lot #487-#491. Nazi-era insignia (swastika): check marketplace/legal rules before listing.

type_en: amber desk seal with insect inclusions
visual_en: Desk seal with a tall natural-shaped handle of transparent cognac amber containing insect inclusions (a fly and long-legged insects) and surface crazing, on a brass collar and a cut-corner square brass matrix engraved with a cursive monogram.
notes_en: #502, #503 and #510 are different sides of the same seal (same collar and base); #506, #511 and #512 are inclusion macros, #508 the seal face. #501, #504, #505, #507 and #509 are pixel-identical copies. MATERIAL: the crazing plus insects could also indicate copal; confirm amber before describing the inclusions.
